topic: Signal strength issues near glass screen
summary_markdown: The conversation addressed an issue where a freelancer could not connect to the sensor's Wi-Fi signal through glass. It was suggested that the screen itself might be causing significant signal shielding, and the thickness of the glass may also contribute. Later, it was noted that the freelancer appeared to have conducted an experiment showing poor reception in an area near the screen (about five meters away), suggesting the TV screen should no longer significantly obstruct the signal there.
